title: Receipts with a non-reimbursable item and a cap
narrative: Volcanic ash, everything shut down, I was stranded for two nights and spent a fortune. Here is everything I paid for.

documents.content:
BOOKING NC5518 — Passenger: Z. ALMEIDA (adult)
Carrier: Northcape (NC)
NC410  KEF 03 Mar 2026 16:00  ->  CPH 03 Mar 2026 21:20
Great-circle distance KEF-CPH: 2,100 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.

From: ops@northcape.example
Sent: 03 Mar 2026 11:30 UTC
Subject: NC410 cancelled

NC410 is cancelled. Icelandic airspace is closed. We will rebook you as soon as the airspace reopens.

NORTHCAPE OPS LOG — NC410 / 03MAR2026
Status: CANCELLED
Cause code: ATC-CLOSE
Cause text: Airspace closed by the air navigation service provider following a volcanic ash advisory. Closure 03MAR 10:00Z to 05MAR 06:00Z. All operators grounded.
Passenger rebooked onto NC414, departing 05 Mar 14:00.

ITEMISED EXPENSES SUBMITTED BY PASSENGER
1. Airport hotel, 2 nights 03-05 Mar ......................... 210.00 units (receipt 7781)
2. Meals, 3 Mar evening ...................................... 31.00 units (receipt 7782)
3. Meals, 4 Mar, three meals ................................. 58.00 units (receipt 7783)
4. Taxi, airport to hotel and return ......................... 21.00 units (receipt 7784)
5. Replacement clothing and toiletries ....................... 95.00 units (receipt 7785)
TOTAL SUBMITTED 415.00 units
CHECK-IN CONFIRMATION NC410 03MAR2026 — ALMEIDA/Z — accepted for travel 14:38Z, seat 6A. Flight subsequently cancelled.

derivation: S3.3(b) airspace closure by the air navigation service provider, not caused by the carrier -> extraordinary
S3.5 does not apply: the closure was still in force at the scheduled departure time
S6.1 duty of care is owed regardless of cause
S6.2(b) hotel 210.00 and airport transfer 21.00 are reimbursable
Replacement clothing is not among the categories in S6.2 and is not reimbursable, so 95.00 is excluded
S6.3 the cap is 300 units per passenger per disruption -> 300 units payable
S6.4 itemised receipts are present for every line
